title: Rabbi Yose bar Elyakim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned once in Berakhot 9b, testifying in the name of the holy congregation in Jerusalem: “Whoever joins the blessing of redemption directly to the Amidah will suffer no harm all day.” Hyman suggests that he may be the brother of Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim, a leading disciple of Rabbi Yochanan.
